eventMetadata.context_description: Tennessee Volunteers' overwhelming talent edge over Miami (OH) RedHawks, as an SEC powerhouse facing a MAC champion, anchors the 82.5% implied probability for a Vols victory in the Music City Bowl. Despite significant opt-outs—including leading rusher Dylan Sampson (1,491 yards) and top receiver Squirrel White—Tennessee's depth from a 10-3 season and recent College Football Playoff experience against Ohio State provides a clear advantage. Miami enters hot at 11-2 after 10 straight wins and a MAC title-clinching victory over Toledo, boasting stout defense led by QB Brett Gabbert, but historical SEC-MAC bowl mismatches and Tennessee's home-state motivation in Nashville sustain trader consensus on a comfortable Vols win.
